tasks.short: Design plans that are safe and accessible.

steps.what: Design plans that keep people safe.
Design plans compliant with the American Disabilities Act.
Check the plans against those Disabilities rules.

tasks.design: The designer designs the plans and judges whether they are safe and compliant. The statement names the American Disabilities Act. National rules decide which accessibility duties apply here. The file stores the plans only after the designer accepts them. A tool does not certify compliance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety and accessibility are a judgement on a particular room. The plans are often copied into the file a second time.
tasks.enabler_now: A file can store plan sheets the designer has already accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A missed clearance or a missed route is a harm to a person, and the designer is the one who judges it.
tasks.human_edge: The designer designs the plans and accepts them. The file stores that version.
tasks.altitude: Designing safe and accessible plans stays with the designer. The file holds the plans only after they accept them.

reach.task: Build from plans the designer accepted
reach.learn: Accessibility was judged by the designer

evidence.claim: Plan sheets the designer has accepted can be stored. Storing them does not certify that the plans are accessible or safe.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a room brief exists and ends when the accepted plans are on the file. Judging safety and accessibility stays with the designer. National rules decide which duties apply. The statement names the American Disabilities Act.
The fields are room, the plan reference the designer drew, and their acceptance. The designer produces the plan. If a sheet is missing, they draw it. Nothing checks compliance on its own.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the design and the check. They disagree only about filing plans the designer has already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the plan-sheet names aligned with the file.
unknowns: Which national accessibility rules apply to this room.
Whether a building authority must still stamp the plans.
research_questions: Which national accessibility rules apply to this room?
Must a building authority still stamp the plans?

already_counted.description: Designing plans compliant with those accessibility rules stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the plan-sheet names aligned with the file

approvals.approved_version: design plans the designer accepted after judging safety and accessibility

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If a building authority must still stamp the plans, that stamp stays, and the low end is the design and the check, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draft construction documents in drawing software.

steps.what: File the construction documents from that drafting.

tasks.design: The designer drafts the construction documents. The software is the board they draw on. The file stores the set only after they accept it. The software does not design the documents.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drafting is the work. Issuing the same sheets into the project file is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A project file can hold construction documents the designer has already drafted and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong dimension is the designer's to catch, because they drew it.
tasks.human_edge: The designer produces the documents by drafting. The file stores that set.
tasks.altitude: Drafting stays with the designer. The file holds the construction documents only after they accept the set they drew.

reach.task: Build from documents the designer drafted
reach.learn: The sheets were drawn by the designer

evidence.claim: Construction documents the designer drafted can be stored after they accept them. The drawing software does not produce the design.

tasks.short: Research health and safety requirements for the design.

steps.what: Research health and safety code requirements.
Read the requirements that inform the design.
Accept the requirements that inform design.

tasks.design: The designer researches health and safety requirements and reads each one that informs the design. The file stores the titles they accepted. It does not write a legal summary and it does not invent a citation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The research is the reading. Copying the accepted titles into the project file is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A project file can hold requirement titles the designer has opened and accepted, from a list the office already keeps.
tasks.still_hard: A requirement that does not apply, or one that does, is the designer's to judge for this room.
tasks.human_edge: The designer reads the requirements and accepts the list. The file stores those titles.
tasks.altitude: Research and reading stay with the designer. The file holds the requirement titles only after they accept them. No citation is generated.

reach.task: See which requirements the designer accepted

evidence.claim: Titles from a code list the office already keeps can be stored after the designer has read and accepted them. No legal summary is written by a tool.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the design needs a health or safety requirement and ends when the accepted titles are on the file. Reading them stays with the designer. Nothing drafts a summary of the law.

Upkeep is keeping the office code-list titles aligned with the file.
unknowns: Which code list the office already keeps.
Whether a specialist must still confirm a requirement for this building.

tasks.short: Confer with the client on the interior.

steps.what: Confer with the client on the budget.
Determine the factors affecting the planning.
Hear architectural preferences, purpose, and function.

tasks.design: The designer confers with the client on budget, architectural preferences, purpose, and function. The conference is not recorded, and nothing is sent afterwards as if it were the client's decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The factors are heard in the conversation. A note written by someone else would not be the conference.
tasks.still_hard: A client can change purpose in the room, and only the person there hears it.
tasks.human_edge: The designer confers with the client. No tool determines the factors.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The conference on budget, preferences, purpose, and function stays with the designer, and it is not recorded.

reach.task: Tell the designer the purpose of the room
reach.learn: The conference was with the designer

evidence.claim: A conference about budget, preferences, purpose, and function is the designer's conversation with the client. It is not recorded.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the client is ready to talk and ends when the designer has heard the factors. No record is written and the call is not recorded.
No fields are stored. The designer produces the understanding in the conference.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree. Incremental hours are zero because no new record and no new tool are added.
unknowns: Whether the client expects a written brief after the conference, as a separate task.
Who else from the client side must be in the room.
research_questions: Does the client expect a written brief after the conference?
Who else from the client side must be in the room?

already_counted.description: The whole of the conference, the factors, and the preferences stays with the designer

incremental.description: No added upkeep while the conference stays with the designer

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The whole conference stays. If the meeting is short, it is still the designer's time with the client, and nothing is saved. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The designer still designs for safety and accessibility, still drafts the construction documents, still reads the code requirements, and still confers with the client. A plan or a document is filed only after they accept it. The conference is not recorded.
reach: An architect builds from plans the designer accepted
A contractor builds from documents the designer drafted
skills_to_grow: Judging accessibility before the plans are filed
Drafting the sheets rather than having them generated
Opening each code title before it is filed
role.ambitious_version: Every filed plan is one the designer judged safe, and every construction document is a sheet they drafted.
